# Tokyo Cheapo

> > Your ultimate guide to budget-friendly travel, living, and exploring Tokyo and Japan without breaking the bank.

Tokyo Cheapo provides comprehensive guides for budget-conscious travelers and residents in Tokyo, covering everything from transportation and dining to cultural experiences and day trips. Founded by Greg Lane and featuring contributions from writers like Lily Crossley-Baxter, the site specializes in making Tokyo accessible and affordable for everyone.

## Key Topics

- Budget travel in Tokyo
- Tokyo transportation (JR Pass, Haneda Airport)
- Tokyo neighborhoods (Shinjuku, Shibuya, Asakusa)
- Day trips from Tokyo (Kamakura, Nikko, Mt. Fuji)
- Tokyo dining and food tours
- Cherry blossoms and hanami spots
- Tokyo events and festivals
- Japanese culture and traditions
- Tattoo-friendly onsen
- Living in Tokyo guides
- Tokyo islands and Izu Islands
- Seasonal Tokyo activities
- Wheelchair accessibility in Tokyo
- Tokyo landmarks (Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo Station)

## Transportation & Getting Around

- [Haneda Airport to Tokyo: See Which Trains & Buses to Catch](https://tokyocheapo.com/travel/transport/cheapest-transport-haneda-airport): Transport options from Haneda Airport (HND) to Tokyo, Shinjuku, Yokohama

## Day Trips & Excursions

- [Top 27 Day Trips From Tokyo](https://tokyocheapo.com/editorial/top-26-day-trips-from-tokyo): 27 day trips from Tokyo including Nikko, Kamakura, Mt. Fuji using JR pass
- [The Tokyo Islands: 9 Oases (Technically) in the Capital](https://tokyocheapo.com/entertainment/visiting-tokyo-islands-guide): Complete guide to 9 Tokyo islands including Izu Islands ferry travel

## Food & Dining Experiences

- [12 Best Tokyo Food Tours: Award-Winning Ramen & More](https://tokyocheapo.com/food-and-drink/best-tokyo-food-tours): 12 Tokyo food tours covering Tsukiji Market, ramen, street food, and sake
- [10 Must-Try Japanese Winter Foods](https://tokyocheapo.com/food-and-drink/japanese-winter-foods): 10 Japanese winter foods including oden, tofu, yuzu, and New Year dishes
- [Nagashi Somen: Where to Eat Flowing Noodles Near Tokyo](https://tokyocheapo.com/food-and-drink/nagashi-somen): Where to try nagashi somen flowing noodles at Chayakado in Kamakura

## Cultural Experiences & Attractions

- [Best Tattoo-Friendly Hot Springs and Baths Around Tokyo](https://tokyocheapo.com/entertainment/the-best-tattoo-friendly-onsen-near-tokyo): List of tattoo-friendly onsen and sento hot springs around Tokyo and Japan
- [Where to See Geisha in Tokyo: Bookable Experiences, Festivals & More](https://tokyocheapo.com/entertainment/japanese-culture-and-tradition/where-to-see-geisha-in-tokyo): Geisha experiences in Tokyo vs Kyoto's Gion district with kaiseki dining
- [Low-Cost Tokyo Night Cruises: 5 Most Popular Picks](https://tokyocheapo.com/entertainment/music-and-nightlife/low-cost-night-cruises-tokyo-bay): Budget yakatabune night cruises on Tokyo Bay with drinks and dining
- [7 Accessible Places To Visit in Tokyo](https://tokyocheapo.com/entertainment/accessible-attractions-tokyo): Wheelchair-accessible Tokyo attractions including Sensōji Temple in Asakusa

## Seasonal Guides & Cherry Blossoms

- [Yaezakura: Where to Enjoy Late-Blooming Cherry Trees in Tokyo](https://tokyocheapo.com/editorial/where-to-see-yaezakura-late-blooming-cherry-trees): Guide to late-blooming yaezakura cherry trees at Tokyo parks like Asukayama

## Living in Tokyo

- [How To Get a Japanese Phone Number](https://tokyocheapo.com/living/how-to-get-a-japanese-phone-number): Guide to getting Japanese phone number and SIM card from Mobal and others
- [Where to Buy and Sell Used Bicycles in Tokyo](https://tokyocheapo.com/lifestyle/buy-sell-used-bicycles-tokyo): Guide to buying used mama-chari bicycles and registration in Tokyo
